gaps.text: Customs data record no crude oil exports from Iran in 2024, against 88.9 Mt in 2018 (CEPII BACI). From 2019 to 2022, 75.4 Mt of them were recorded under "Other Asia, not elsewhere specified" and are shown as "Asia, not specified". Unrecorded shipments, or cargoes declared under other origins, are a plausible cause; it is not established here.
Urea exports of Iran in customs data fell from 3.77 Mt in 2019 to 0.024 Mt in 2024 (CEPII BACI). A change in the recorded origin of shipments is a plausible cause; it is not established here.

Customs data record 0.00769 Mt of LPG exports from Iran in 2024, against 8.44 Mt in 2022 (CEPII BACI). Unrecorded shipments, or cargoes declared under other origins, are a plausible cause; it is not established here. The atlas has no free source that measures this gap, so it is not quantified.
